financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: On July 28, 2022, we issued 116,953 shares of common stock for $1,755 in cash to our Chief Financial Officer upon the exercise of options.

warrants.quote: On July 1, 2022, the Company issued a warrant to purchase up to 50,000 shares of its common stock at an exercise price of $1.38 per share to a consultant for services.
